facts.assertion: Scope: 22 X-Sb-O composition libraries, 14 X elements (Mg, Al, Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Y, Ag, In, La, Pb, Bi); 1402 distinct photoanode samples; 7010 PEC experiments = 5608 CAs (4 LEDs x 1402) + 1402 CVs.

facts.assertion: Photoactive ('hit') criteria: photocurrent > 1e-8 A AND photocurrent > dark current at 1.23 V vs RHE (to reject photoconductors). No EQE threshold is used; EQE is the figure of merit.
facts.locator: Results and Discussion, para on Figure 1c

facts.assertion: Of 1402 samples at 3.2 eV: 1138 show photoactivity, 148 have dark > photo and are excluded, 264 show none -> 990 photoactive samples. (Local Fig1c csv reproduces 990/148/264.)

facts.assertion: Representative sample per phase = max EQE among samples whose phase concentration exceeds 80%; 19 photoactive phases; 169 max-EQE values (phase x anneal T x electrolyte x photon energy).

facts.assertion: Hit rate for broad spectral response: 9 of 19 phases active at 2.1 eV (47%) vs 4 of 49 (8.1%) in the group's prior survey of metal oxide photoanodes.

facts.assertion: Best photoanodes reported: Sb-rich cubic AgSbO3 (*AgSbO3-c, y~0.79, 550 C, pH 10 SLF10) has highest EQE at 3.2 eV; InSbO4 (y~0.44-0.47, 700 C on Pt/Ti/Si) has highest EQE at 2.1 eV and is called 'most surprising'; Cr- and Pb-based (CrSbO4, Pb2Sb2O7, Pb2.5Sb1.5O6.75) highlighted for Pourbaix stability + broad spectral response; am-NiSbOz highest among amorphous.
